summary: Require short-lived, one-time, payload-bound confirmation before FedEx mutations and stop agent mode from granting write authority.
reason: Billable and state-changing shipment and pickup requests must not execute from a single agent-generated call or from --agent alone; a reviewed request must be cryptographically bound to a durable pending operation and consumed at most once.
validated_outcome: Tests prove previews make no FedEx request, confirmations bind the action, normalized origin, method, path, and exact canonical request, concurrent or replayed consumption cannot execute twice, --agent does not imply --yes, bare --yes cannot authorize any state-changing client path, and action-specific previews include redacted target, timing, package, and weight details.
